newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, but off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, but off early lows.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended slightly down but off their lows in a dull market on Wednesday and the index recovered towards the close on short-covering in select blue chips, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended down 1.61 points, or 0.11 percent, at 1,487.58. Losers beat gainers 152 to 124.

"Sentiment was weak and major players kept to the sidelines due to political and economic uncertainty," one dealer said. "But the index recovered towards the close on short-covering in select blue chips."
PTCL rose 0.30 rupees to 28.65. Fauji Fertilizer fell 3.25 to 72.75.
